failure_summary.description: The correct referent was given in a noncanonical form or at an unnecessarily expanded level of specificity.
The answer substituted a related fact or entity for the exact semantic role requested by the clue.

patch.reasoning: The existing skill already requires concise canonical answers at the requested specificity and careful identification of the exact entity or relation. These failures reflect not following those rules, rather than a missing generalizable rule; adding similar instructions would be redundant.
